name: Unfortunate News

angles.text: The recovered artifact is a damaged, glowing blue crystal recovered from a cultist, hinting at arcane or mystical practices under investigation by High Elder Shadowsong.

faq.answer: "Unfortunate News" is a quest in WoW Forever that follows the death of a defecting cultist. After discovering the turncoat slain, you recover a mysterious glowing crystal from the corpse and report back to High Elder Shadowsong.
faq.q: What is the quest Unfortunate News?

faq.answer: The turncoat was a defecting cultist whom an adventurer was sent to meet or secure. However, they were killed before they could speak or escape, leaving behind only their still-warm corpse and a damaged crystal.
Talanaanis Shadowsong is an elf, the High Elder located in Valanaar. He directs investigations into the cultists and receives the damaged crystal found on the turncoat's body.

It is a small, glowing blue crystal recovered from beneath the fallen turncoat cultist. Although visibly damaged, High Elder Shadowsong finds it interesting and considers it a clue worthy of further study.
faq.q: What is the damaged blue crystal?

faq.answer: Valanaar is the settlement or outpost where High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong resides and where you return to deliver your report and the salvaged crystal.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

aliases: what quest comes before unfortunate news
faq.answer: This quest immediately follows "The Turncoat," in which an adventurer sets out to find the defecting cultist, only to arrive too late to save them.
faq.q: How does this quest connect to The Turncoat?

sections.body: In WoW Forever, "Unfortunate News" recounts the grim aftermath of an attempted rendezvous with a defecting cultist. An adventurer dispatched to meet the turncoat discovers the informer already slain, their body still warm when reached. Tucked beneath the corpse is a small, glowing blue crystal—damaged, yet still humming with enough presence to warrant an immediate report to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
sections.title: A Broken Rendezvous

sections.body: Upon returning to Valanaar alone, the adventurer delivers word that the turncoat died before any testimony could be gathered. While the loss of a live contact is a serious setback, the recovered blue crystal catches the High Elder's eye. He finds the damaged crystal interesting and takes it from you.
sections.title: Shadowsong's Investigation

summary: Unfortunate News is a quest in WoW Forever following an attempt to contact a defecting cultist. Arriving to find the informant already dead, the adventurer recovers a damaged, glowing blue crystal from the body and delivers it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
